headword: {総量規制|そうりょうきせい}
gloss: cap on the total amount; total-volume restriction

definitions.gloss: total-volume restriction; cap on the total amount
definitions.explanation: A rule that limits the total amount of something rather than each unit: total emissions of a pollutant from an area, total bank lending to a sector, or the total a person may borrow. In everyday talk it usually means the rule that caps consumer loans at one third of the borrower's annual income.

examples.japanese: {総量規制|そうりょうきせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
{総量規制|そうりょうきせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦これ{以上|いじょう}→これ以上：25431_koreijou⟧⟦{借|か}りられない→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the borrowing cap, I can't borrow any more.

examples.english: The 1990 cap on total real-estate lending is said to have set off the collapse of the bubble.

notes:
Two uses are famous in Japan: the 1990 cap on bank lending for real estate, which helped burst the bubble economy, and the consumer-credit rule of 2010 that bars lenders from lending a person more than a third of their annual income (⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧3⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧1).
